WITH type_averages AS (
  SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_average_price
  FROM Products
  GROUP BY production_type_code
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_baseline
  FROM Products
),
above_baseline AS (
  SELECT t.production_type_code, t.type_average_price, b.overall_baseline
  FROM type_averages t
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE b.overall_baseline IS NOT NULL
    AND t.type_average_price > b.overall_baseline
),
kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(type_average_price) AS mean_kept_type_average
  FROM above_baseline
),
remaining AS (
  SELECT a.type_average_price, a.overall_baseline, m.mean_kept_type_average
  FROM above_baseline a
  CROSS JOIN kept_mean m
  WHERE a.type_average_price > m.mean_kept_type_average
)
SELECT AVG(type_average_price) AS average_type_price,
       AVG(type_average_price - overall_baseline) AS average_above_overall_baseline,
       AVG(type_average_price - mean_kept_type_average) AS average_above_kept_types_mean
FROM remaining;
